text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Epi-senpai! You've been 
so kind and helpful to me, I don't even 
know how to repay you...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
This much is a given! Because you're an 
Umamusume that I feel—a fated connection 
with!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
D-Destiny...!? Hawawa... My heart skipped 
a beat...!!

text_block_list.name: Epi's Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, wasn't I the destined one?!" 
"Senpai, didn't you say the exact same 
thing to me?" "Wait, it wasn't just me 
who's destined...?!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
W-Why are you so angry...? Isn't having so 
many destined encounters a wonderful 
thing...?
